definition.candidates: Orange: any F face nearest to at least one saved boundary edge-midpoint sample, regardless of distance; no illegality/semantic label.
definition.depth_method: Inherited CPU finite barycentric z-buffer; only exact/1e-12 depth ties favor earlier C.
definition.depth_views: Whole azimuth -60 / elevation 23; local azimuth 120 / elevation 28
definition.distance_query: Saved deterministic source-boundary edge midpoints, in source edge-ID order; vertices have zero length weight and are excluded from plotted curves.
definition.distance_targets: Finite F surface, all finite F edges, F-open finite edges, F vertices; no C self-match.
definition.distance_x: Cumulative source edge length / L, concatenated in sorted source edge ID order. Adjacent plotted intervals need not be spatial neighbors.
definition.distance_y: Distance / L * 100, symmetric-log axis with .2 percent linear region; fixed limits across all registered states of the same parent.
definition.local_scale: C bbox plus fixed .075L X/Z and .10L Y margins; all registered states of the same C share scale.
definition.observation_limit: Raster misses subpixel gaps; exact coincident sections can overprint. Orange nearest faces can be distant or semantically unrelated. These figures are not a legal-connectivity, thickness or adoption certification.
definition.sections: Finite triangle intersections with Z=center(C bbox Z) and X=center(C bbox X). Positions depend only on C.
definition.whole_scale: Union of all registered outputs per parent, all noise/model/stage states; common world scale.
